what.text: This page follows refugees from Poland in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1368 Polish refugees, and Germany hosted 36.1% of them.
After Germany, the largest hosts are Canada, Denmark and Sweden.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Poland, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1988 to 1991, 1994 to 1995 and 2005.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1970 at 150 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 35934, at the end of 1994.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
